controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by HIP 8152; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured color.
controls.notes: No image or color of HIP 8152 c is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the color of hip-8152's light, as its color dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of HIP 8152's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 8152 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

HIP 8152 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (3, 30, 97) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 164767175, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 51 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.

physical.credit: Radius from Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; mass from Polanski et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; orbit from Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive
